messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Canary deploy `service-inference@2026.03.15-canary-7` triggered elevated error rate. p95 latency -> 3.2s (baseline 700ms), p99 -> 7.8s, 5xx rate 4.3% over last 2m. Automatically created incident channel.
sre-ana: I’m on it. Paging eng-bob and runtime-carla.
eng-bob: Got the page, joining. seeing the same in dashboards — tail latency jumps aligned with canary traffic window.
runtime-carla: I can repro locally-ish — long stalls in KV cache lookups when sequence_length grows. logs show a lot of `kvcache: miss` followed by retries.
support-diego: Any customer-facing impact so far? Support queue has 3 reports of slow responses for embeddings API.
product-emma: We have active demo customers hitting the canary. Need quick assessment for SLA and customer comms.
infra-frank: Infra metrics: all GPU nodes show normal util; no obvious OOMs. Network retries are up on the gateway tier.
sre-ana: Initial mitigation options: 1) Pause canary traffic 2) Rollback canary to previous commit 3) Enable fallback model variant (smaller) for canary bucket. Which is fastest?
eng-bob: Pause traffic first to stop new user requests hitting canary — triggering immediate decrease in error surface while we dig.
runtime-carla: Pausing will buy time but tails still draining. Rollback is fastest long-term. Fallback variant might reduce latency but could mask root cause.
sre-ana: @eng-bob please pause canary.
eng-bob: pausing canary now via deploy-control: `./deployctl pause --target service-inference:canary-7`
incident-bot: Confirmed: canary traffic paused at 1718254360. p95 trending down to 1.0s in the next minute.
support-diego: Queue update: no new customer tickets after pause, existing ones updated with "Investigating".
product-emma: We should prepare a brief customer note if rollback is required. Drafting now.
runtime-carla: While paused — collecting heap traces and kvcache metrics. I see spike in cache misses correlating with longer sequences (>=2048 tokens). New quantized kernel in this build seems to change prefetch behavior.
eng-bob: If quantized kernel is the suspect, a rollback to the previous kernel (canary-6) would revert it. Can we rollback the canary quickly?
sre-ana: We need approval to rollback. Is there risk to DB migrations? Not seeing any migrations in this deploy.
infra-frank: No infra changes in this canary. Rollback is low risk.
product-emma: Approve rollback. Customer comms: "We detected increased latency affecting a subset of users; rolling back a recent canary while we investigate. Will update in 30m."
eng-bob: initiating rollback: `./deployctl rollback service-inference --to canary-6`
incident-bot: Rollback initiated at 1718254410. Automatic health checks in progress.
sre-ana: Monitoring metrics: p95 -> 850ms, p99 -> 1.2s, 5xx -> 0.2% and counting down. Looks like rollback helped.
runtime-carla: I’ve captured traces from the failing canary and uploaded to /internal/trace/1718254321/canary-7. Key stack shows `kv_fetch_with_retries` invoking quant-kernel path. 
eng-bob: Good capture. We’ll pin quant-kernel version for canary and run targeted perf tests.
product-emma: Sent customer message to impacted demo accounts with ETA and link to status page.
support-diego: I'll follow up on the three tickets and escalate if anything resurfaces.
infra-frank: Leaving autoscaling and gateway backpressure at normal — no manual changes required.
sre-ana: Action items: 1) runtime to run canary-7 regression locally (carla) 2) eng to create hotfix/rollback PR to pin kernel and add extra kvcache metrics (eng-bob) 3) comms draft for status page (product-emma) 4) postmortem template created (sre-ana).
runtime-carla: Started local repro and adding kvcache debug logs. Found one retry loop that doesn't short-circuit on certain error codes — adding guard.
eng-bob: Opening PR: `github.com/redwood-inference/service-inference/pull/5421` with rollback and extra metrics.
incident-bot: Incident state: mitigated -> canary paused and rolled back. Please add any follow-ups to the incident runbook.
sre-ana: Handoff: I’ll keep this open for 2 hours for follow-up checks. If everything stays green, we’ll close and schedule a postmortem. @product-emma any immediate customer escalations?
product-emma: Not yet beyond the three tickets. We’ll escalate to account teams if customers ask.
support-diego: Notified customer success on the three impacted customers.
runtime-carla: Uploading final debug artifacts and a short repro script to the ticket.
eng-bob: After tests, we'll re-run canary with pinned kernel + extra logging during a low-traffic window.
sre-ana: Thanks team. Closing active paging for now — keeping thread open for notes.
product-emma: Great job everyone.
eng-bob: quick note for postmortem: include wall-clock correlation of sequence length distribution during canary and the kernel selection logs.
incident-bot: Incident closed for paging at 1718254500. Remember to file postmortem within 72h. :white_check_mark:
